findings.title: Bound and clean up the Codex auth runtime on every path
findings.description: The design introduces runtime I/O for login, logout, and account lookup, but its explicit timeout and disconnect handling is incomplete for those paths. `codex.login_timeout_s` bounds only `handle.wait()`; it does not bound runtime startup or the initial `login_chatgpt()` / `login_chatgpt_device_code()` call. The account timeout covers status and post-login confirmation, but no timeout is specified for logout. The turn failure table handles a transport close during a turn, but does not say how disconnects or SDK errors during login/logout are surfaced. Finally, cancellation specifies `handle.cancel()` but does not state that the `AsyncCodex` runtime is shut down in a `finally` path for login/logout. Specify timeout, disconnect/error behavior, and runtime cleanup for each auth operation so these new I/O paths cannot hang or leave an orphaned subprocess.
